home.title: MortgageMentor
home.tagline: A smart simulation tool for understanding mortgages in Israel
home.description: The goal of this app is to help couples and individuals understand how much mortgage they need, what their expected monthly payment will be, how different loan tracks affect risk, and which questions to ask before approaching the bank.

features.title: Monthly payment calculation
features.description: An initial monthly payment estimate based on loan amount, interest rate, and term.

features.title: Track mix comparison
features.description: Later we will add comparisons between fixed unlinked, prime, variable, and CPI-linked tracks.

features.title: Risk simulation
features.description: We will explore what happens to your payment if interest rates rise or the CPI changes.

calculator.title: Mortgage Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Monthly payment calculation for a mortgage mix — one or more fixed-rate unlinked tracks, using the Spitzer or equal-principal method.
calculator.repaymentMethodsHelp: With Spitzer the total payment is generally stable while the split between principal and interest changes over time. With equal principal the same principal amount is repaid each month, so the payment starts higher and decreases over time.
calculator.trackAmountHelp: The part of the mortgage repaid under this track's terms. The total mortgage is the sum of all tracks.
calculator.trackTypeHelp: The track type determines how the interest behaves. In a fixed unlinked track the rate is constant and the principal is not CPI-linked, so the payment is known in advance.
calculator.repaymentMethodHelp: How the loan is repaid: Spitzer — a generally stable total payment; equal principal — a payment that starts higher and decreases over time.
calculator.yearsHelp: A longer duration lowers the monthly payment but increases the total interest.
calculator.interestRateHelp: The nominal annual rate exactly as the bank quotes it in the offer.
calculator.invalidInput: Invalid input. Make sure every track has a valid amount, rate, and duration.
calculator.combinedFirstPaymentHelp: The sum of all track payments in the first month. With an equal-principal track, the combined payment decreases over time.
calculator.totalPaymentHelp: All payments combined: the borrowed principal plus all the interest.
calculator.totalInterestHelp: How much you pay the bank on top of what you borrowed, over the whole term.
calculator.effectiveRateHelp: The annual rate you effectively pay once monthly interest charging (compounding) is taken into account.
calculator.mixHelp: Each track is calculated independently, and the total monthly payment is the sum of the tracks still active in that month. When a shorter track ends, the combined monthly payment goes down.
scheduleIntro: Every monthly payment is split in two: principal and interest. The principal is the part that reduces your loan balance; the interest is the price you pay the bank for the money.
With the Spitzer method the monthly payment is nearly constant, but its composition changes: early payments are mostly interest, while later payments mostly reduce the principal.
The remaining balance after each month is the principal you still owe the bank following that payment.
calculator.disclaimer: This is a monthly simulation for illustration only, not a binding bank offer.
